stages.headline: Compute 3 857 + 4 268.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Units 7 + 8 = 15, carry 1. 2. Tens 5 + 6 + 1 = 12, carry 1. 3. Hundreds 8 + 2 + 1 = 11, carry 1. 4. Thousands 3 + 4 + 1 = 8. 5. 8 125.
